title: Largest Potential Outlier
body:
An array of n integers was built from n - 2 normal numbers plus their sum (that is n - 1 values), and then one more value, the outlier, was added. The outlier is neither one of the normal numbers nor their sum. More than one value may qualify as the outlier; find the greatest such value.

It is guaranteed that a valid outlier exists.

Function to complete

Complete getOutlierValue(arr). It returns the greatest value that can be the outlier.

  • arr: the array of integers

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: The first line is n. Each of the next n lines is one array element.
out: The value your function returns (the driver prints it): the greatest value that can be the outlier.
cons: A valid outlier is guaranteed to exist

samples.ex: Removing 16 leaves [4, 1, 3, 2, 10] whose first four sum to 10, and removing 4 leaves [1, 3, 16, 2, 10] whose others sum to 16. Both 16 and 4 are potential outliers; the greater is 16.
The specials [2, 2] sum to 4, leaving 3 as the outlier.

lc: 3371 Identify the Largest Outlier in an Array
